xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:NatureAndDetailsOfTheActionsTa: Judgement of Honorable Supreme Court of India in relation to write down of AT1 Bonds ORDER PASSED 1. The appeals challenging the order of Honorable Bombay High Court, setting aside the write down of the AT1 Bonds, are dismissed. Interim order, if any, stands vacated. 2. The payment of annual coupon rate shall remain unaffected by the outcome of these appeals and must be made in terms of the Information Memorandum. 3. Parties are left to bear their own costs. 4. Pending proceedings may be taken to its logical conclusion uninfluenced by the judgement.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ExpectedImpactOfActionsTakenOn: Bank is currently reviewing the order and its implications and will make suitable disclosures in due course. Particularly with respect to Capital adequacy, pro-forma impact of re-instatement of AT1 Bonds principal amount on CET1 Ratio (including Profits) as on June 30, 2026 is expected to be approx 250 bps. Tier1 Ratio on a proforma basis to remain unimpacted at 14.0 percent.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfAnyAberrationsOrNonCo: The contravention relates to an action undertaken by the Administrator in March 2020, in reference to the Bank’s reconstruction. The Honorable Supreme Court has upheld the decision of the Honorable Bombay High Court which had set aside the order of the Administrator to write down the At1 Bonds aggregating to Rs. 8,415 crore.
